scope: First-party binary64 original-data physical preparation and independent-component minimum-energy solver; unchanged legacy1/2 processors.
operator: Same submitted float32 node mass/volume/centres, bond centroids and applied forces; binary64 sphere inertia, geometric mass mean, mean lever length, normalization, B, physical right factor, RHS and final physical scaling. K remains caller binary64; public output casts once tofloat32.
factorAdmission: Retain all-finite factor casts and nonzero float32 physical Cholesky diagonal modes after native row permutation; no regularization, epsilon clipping, or physical mode removal.
rowWhitening: Existing complete unshifted sparse anchored/principal Gram factor where its positive factor exists. A rejected Gram pivot routes only its original connected component through unshifted original-principal-transpose HouseholderQR, preserving every original row and physical mode.
minimumEnergy: Invertible anchored row transformations retain the consistent feasible set. Detached components keep the original inertia-weighted least-squares norm and range(A^T) direction space; no rank threshold, nullspace projection, pivot shift, artificial support or physical mode removal. Topology changes reset the private solution.
admission: Fresh original-data binary64 B^T(rhs-Ax) under unchanged actualf32 tolerance1e-6; independent original physical energy/traction/all-row-reference gates and publicf32 conversion envelope remain required.
iterationBudget: Each configured iteration sweep permits at most one update per active disconnected component. Max25 sweeps per call, unchanged caller32-pass bound; per-component update count is therefore at most800. Summed updates, reorthogonalization projections and retained numeric payload bytes are separately exposed; they are not hidden in the sweep count.
compatibility: The old configure_sections export still selects exact revision2. Revision3 has a separate opt-in export, revision getter/progress identity, and requires separately versioned Engine checkpoints.
validationStatus: New isolated source only. Prior v3-06 and QR-only failures are preserved; no native admission until manufactured/captures/reference/mass/current fullwall gates.
zeroLoad: An exactly unloaded component resets to its zero minimum-energy solution, including partial unload in a disconnected family. Global original-gradient admission remains fresh and unchanged.

workAbi.storageScope: Numeric/vector payloads only. Allocator/container overhead and transient factorization maps are not a total-memory measurement.

rightPreconditioning: Free direction P*g, g=A^T*r, P=A^T*C^-2*A, is SPD on range(A^T). Apply the existing exact forward/reverse factors twice, then minimize against the unweighted original A-action and residual with complete two-pass reorthogonalization. This numerical partition adds no physical support, omits no physical row, projects no load/null mode, and introduces no rank threshold or pivot shift.
qrPreconditioner: J=A_principal^T=Q1 R; apply P=Q diag(R^-T R^-1,I) Q^T. The numerical complement is identity. No numerical support, spectrum cutoff, nullspace projection, pivot shift, damping, or physical mass/K edit.
